messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've been busy decorating
my room with dusty old
fossils, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}I always want my room on
the cutting edge of
interior design.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen olnud hõivatud oma
toa kaunistamisega tolmuste
fossiilidega, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Ma tahan alati, et mu tuba
oleks sisekujunduse
tipptasemel.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Tee hee hee!{01 00 00 0f 00} Having
a fossil in your room is
the best.
{07 15 00}It's like having a friend
who does nothing but
listen, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hihihii!{01 00 00 0f 00} Fossiil toas
on kõige
parem.
{07 15 00}See on nagu sõber, kes
ei tee muud kui
kuulab, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've got this fantastic
fossil in my room right
now, {04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}It's like a worry doll. {01 00 00 0a 00}I tell
it all of my problems.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mul on praegu toas see
fantastiline
fossiil, {04 02 00}. {07 00 00}See
on nagu murenukk. {01 00 00 0a 00}Ma räägin
talle kõigist oma muredest.
